key_insight: Large language models are built on core numerical linear algebra operations, so advances in matrix and tensor methods directly shape their training, inference, and scalability.
engineering_relevance: For computational scientists and engineers, understanding LLMs as linear-algebraic systems clarifies performance bottlenecks and points to more efficient and stable algorithms.
method: Explains LLM fundamentals in numerical linear algebra terms
Maps attention, embeddings, and training to matrix/tensor computations
Surveys recent NLA contributions relevant to modern ML systems
evidence_signal: The paper is a survey and does not report new experiments; its support comes from synthesizing existing LLM and NLA methods and contributions.
watch_item: Because the article is conceptual rather than benchmark-driven, practical gains from NLA ideas must still be validated on real LLM workloads and hardware.
paper_title: The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models
